SearchPage.title: Search
SearchPage.advNote: Narrows to records containing all the words you enter. Call number matches by prefix. Can be combined with the keyword box.

HomePage.title: Home
HomePage.featuresDescription: Search the catalogue, search the text, see the whole collection, or take the data. Choose the entry point that fits.
HomePage.featureSearchDescription: Narrow by title, author, call number and classification to browse the pamphlets.
HomePage.featureFulltextDescription: Search OCR text across the collection. Matches are highlighted on the page images.
HomePage.featureVisualizeDescription: Charts of classification, year of publication, and the names that appear in the text. Move from a chart straight into the matching search.
HomePage.featureApiDescription: IIIF, DTS and JSON APIs let you use the images and text in other viewers and research tools.
HomePage.featureAboutDescription: How the Morrison Pamphlets came together, and how this database is compiled.

ApiDocsPage.title: API Documentation
ApiDocsPage.description: A list of the APIs this database exposes. Each endpoint is described in OpenAPI 3.1 and is available at /api/openapi.json.

FulltextSearchPage.title: Fulltext Search
FulltextSearchPage.description: Search through OCR text of Morrison Pamphlets at page level. Enter a search term to find pages with highlighted matching text.

VisualizePage.title: Visualizations
VisualizePage.lead: See the shape of the collection by classification, year of publication, and the names that appear in the text. Select anything in a chart to open the matching search results.
VisualizePage.unavailable: The figures could not be loaded just now. Please try again shortly.
VisualizePage.showTable: See the figures as a table
VisualizePage.classificationLead: Counts for each division of the 1972 classified catalogue. Area stands for the number of items. Larger divisions are broken down further by call number (P-III-a and so on).
VisualizePage.classificationNote: Names are omitted where a tile is too small to hold one; hover or focus a tile to see it. Every figure is listed in the table below.
VisualizePage.yearLead: Items that carry a year of publication, counted by year. Select a bar to narrow the search to that period.
VisualizePage.yearMissing: {count} items carry no year of publication and are not shown here.
VisualizePage.entityTitle: People, places and organisations in the text
VisualizePage.entityLead: Names extracted automatically from the OCR text. Counts are the number of pages on which a name appears. Select a name to open the pages where it actually occurs.
VisualizePage.entityNote: {count} pages carry a name of this kind. Extraction is automatic, so it contains errors and omissions; it is being applied to items as their text becomes available.
VisualizePage.authorLead: The authors credited on the largest number of items. Select a name to narrow the search to that author.
VisualizePage.authorNote: Items with no author recorded are not counted.
VisualizePage.coverageTitle: How far the full text reaches
VisualizePage.coverageLead: For each division, the share of items whose text has been captured by OCR. Select a row to see the items in that division that have full text.
VisualizePage.coverageNote: Items without full text can still be read as page images.
